title: Yellow Smoked British Cod Fish And Chips
description: A malty, silky, date-night British dish featuring smoked paprika and a mirepoix base, this ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly fish and chips recipe is sure to impress, made with yellow smoked British cod and served with a side of crispy chips.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the diced onion, grated carrot, and diced celery.
Add the smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Cut the potatoes into long thin strips and rinse them in cold water to remove excess starch.
Dry the potato strips with paper towels and fry them in hot oil until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the chips from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Dip each cod fillet into the mirepoix mixture, coating it evenly.
Place the coated cod fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and drizzle with malt vinegar.
Bake the cod fillets in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until they are cooked through and flake easily with a fork.
Serve the baked cod with the crispy chips and a side of malt vinegar for dipping.
